caseName: Prudence Co. v. Fidelity & Deposit Co.
caseNameFull: Prudence Company, Inc. v. Fidelity & Deposit Co.

opinions.text: It is ordered that the mandate of this Court in the above-entitled cause on file in the District Court of the United States for the *643Southern District of New York be, and the same is hereby, recalled; and that said mandate be amended so as to give petitioner recovery for additional costs in the sum of $908.40, being the expenses incurred in furnishing records for the use of this Court.
